leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a generic container class to store dependencies with type safety.
Construct a registration method that binds service identifiers to their implementations.
Configure a resolution method to retrieve and instantiate dependencies from the container.
Apply dependency injection patterns by integrating the container into a sample application.
Manipulate the container to handle both singleton and transient service lifetimes.
Initialize the container with a set of predefined services and validate their types.
Update the container to support optional dependencies and default implementations.
